mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points in the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% for three consecutive months, it indicates monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 0.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) and weak job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% month-over-month) signal labor market stagnation that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery (HOUST growth > 0.5% month-over-month and GDPC1 growth > 0.5% quarter-over-quarter), increased construction activity and consumer confidence boost corporate revenues, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST growth exceeds 0.5% and GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5% quarter-over-quarter, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) consistently signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5% in a single month, it indicates severe labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% year-over-year) and weak industrial production (INDPRO growth < 0.3% month-over-month) signal stagflationary pressures that lead to central bank tightening and reduced corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% yoy and INDPRO growth < 0.3% mom
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth < 0.5% month-over-month), industrial output contraction reduces corporate investment and supply chain efficiency, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth is below 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
